address: Shop 1031, 1F, The Promenade, Galaxy, Avenida de Cotai, Cotai, Macau
bio: This award-winning Macao outpost offers the same exquisite fine-dining experience as its Hong Kong flagship. A single set tasting menu focuses on Sicilian cuisine – the appetisers awaken the tastebuds with ingenious food combinations, the hand-rolled pasta is simply divine and the hazelnut soufflé with a runny centre an exquisite surprise. Caring service befits the quality of the food....
